question: Explain the provisions for filing a belated return and a revised return of income under the Income-tax Act, 1961.
keywords: three months prior to the end

points.label: Belated return: meaning
points.description: A person who has not filed a return within the time allowed under section 139(1) may file a belated return.

points.label: Time limit
points.description: Both a belated and a revised return can be filed up to three months before the end of the relevant assessment year or before completion of assessment, whichever is earlier.

points.label: Consequences of filing late
points.description: A late filer pays a fee for delay and interest on tax due, and cannot carry forward most losses (such as business and capital losses).

points.label: Revised return: meaning
points.description: If a person finds an omission or wrong statement in an original or belated return, he may file a revised return.

points.label: Effect of revision
points.description: A belated return can itself be revised; the revised return replaces the original, and it can be revised more than once within the time limit.
